Hello Neko-san, I am Poneko and I would love to get an illustration from you!
Reference of the Poneko: https://imgur.com/a/s2SQUlC
Her personality is impish, mischievous, and cheerful.
She has a light tan and two fangs.

I would like you to emulate the poses and expressions of Yoidore Shirazu, but with Poneko holding a lolipop instead of a cigarette. I will be using this artwork for a cover of the song and will credit you. Please do not change Poneko's hairstyle and cat ears, but add any accessories that you like. Please feel free to dress Poneko in whatever clothes you wish.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vB8sxY_PJ_w

I would like the following expressions:
1) Eyes closed
2)Eyes half-open
3) Eyes wide-open

4)Neutral Mouth closed
5) Tongue out
6)Smile Mouth closed
7) Smile Mouth open

Please make the image 1920 x 1080. Please separate the eyes, mouth, character, and background into separate layers.

I only recently discovered your artwork, but I instantly fell in love. I love how detailed your rendering of faces and hair. You have such a beautiful feminine style!
